description: Create up to 30 products in one rikma in one call — each with the same fields as createRikmaProduct: name, description, price, stock, pictures (picId + galleryIds), categories, options and variants. Every item is created and answered on its own (results[i] with productId, or why it failed); one failure never stops the rest. A product whose extras failed is still created and marked partial. Members only. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#createRikmaProductsBatchTool

galleryIds.description: More upload ids, in order, after the cover.

kindOf.description: How the price is counted. Default total.

options.description: Option axes to make sure exist on the rikma before the variants (e.g. size, colour).

key.description: Stable key (default: derived from the name), e.g. "size".

name.description: Option name as shoppers see it, e.g. "Size" / "מידה".

value.description: Stable value key (default: derived from the label).

picId.description: Upload id of the cover picture.

price.description: Base price in the rikma currency.

quant.description: Stock of a product without variants: a count, -1 unlimited, omit for 0.

variants.description: Variants to create. On a rikma with other members, new variants of a product go to the partners as one proposal.

active.description: false hides the variant from the shop (kept for old orders). Operational.

compareAtPrice.description: The "was" price shown struck through. Operational.

imageIds.description: Upload ids of this variant's own pictures. Operational.

name.description: Display name; default: the option labels ("M / Red").

optionValues.description: The variant's options, by option key or name and value or label: { "size": "M", "color": "Red" }.

price.description: Variant price; null = the product's price. A price that differs from the current one is a term (proposal on a rikma product).

quant.description: Stock: a count, or -1 for unlimited. Operational — applied at once.

sku.description: Unique within the rikma. Omit on a new variant for a suggested one.

variantId.description: Update this variant. Omit to match by optionValues (an existing combination is updated, a new one is created).

projectId.description: Rikma (project) id, from findUserProjectsTool. You must be a member.

name: createRikmaProductsBatchTool
